name_en: Fuxin Fuyi Industry Co., Ltd. (Fuyi Group)
name_cn: 阜新福壹实业有限公司
main_products: Medical scrubs, chef and corporate uniforms, hi-vis safety workwear, softshell and fleece jackets
woven_evidence: Its main lines are scrubs, chef and corporate uniforms and hi-vis workwear, usually woven poly-cotton, though it also offers fleece jackets.

canton_fair.evidence_note: The company blog invites buyers to its booth 2.1E25-27 & F18-20 at the 139th Canton Fair, May 1-5, 2026.

notes: The company says all products are made in its own factory in Yangon, Myanmar, not in China, so Layer 2 should decide whether that fits. It calls itself a wholesale uniform company. A related site, fuyiworkwear.com, also mentions the 138th fair. Published WhatsApp: +86 15306753170.
